title: Battle of Jenné
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Jenné", at revision 1381056631, opens: "The Battle of Jenné was a military engagement between forces of the Mali Empire and the Moroccan Pashalik of Timbuktu." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871323, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1599 battle between Morocco and the Mali Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
